output.summary: Revenue growth tracks an external price rally (corn +46%, soybeans +36%) while volume is flat; the cooperative ranks mid-pack against peers, none of which adopted a program. The program's credit is not supported. The 6% cost-per-bushel gain comes entirely from maintenance cut by about a third, while deferred work orders tripled and the insurer found critical dust and monitoring defects at Harlan Junction with a 21 November deadline. Succession and documentation gaps are real. Fixing Harlan safety and starting knowledge capture are clearly warranted. Approving the expansion now, or holding maintenance and the hiring freeze, is unjustified. Expansion viability and any suppression of safety reports remain unestablished.
